CFML Language Reference: Functions

Int

Rounds a number down to the nearest whole number.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Int(number)

Parameters

number
Any number, or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

An integer.

Usage

"Down" means toward negative infinity: Int(3.7) is 3 but Int(-3.7) is -4. Use Fix to round toward zero, Ceiling to round up, and Round for the nearest integer.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>number</TH><TH>Int(number)</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="n" LIST="3.7,3.2,3,-3.2,-3.7">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Int(n)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<CFSET Minutes = 197>
<CFOUTPUT><P>#Minutes# minutes is #Int(Minutes / 60)# hours and #Minutes MOD 60# minutes.</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Fix, Ceiling, Round, Val
